feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Hub Group, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against Hub Group, Inc. and its officers, alleging violations of federal securities laws. The lawsuit claims that Hub Group's financial statements from Q1 2023 to Q3 2025 contained material misstatements regarding revenue, income, and costs. Investors who purchased Hub Group securities between April 28, 2023, and May 11, 2026, are encouraged to join the lawsuit, with a lead plaintiff deadline of August 28, 2026.

feed.title: Could Investing $300 a Month in VOO Make You a Millionaire? Here's the Math.
feed.summary: Investing $300 a month in the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) could make you a millionaire, depending on the average annual returns. Historically, the S&P 500 has averaged 10% annual returns, but VOO has performed even better in recent years, averaging almost 15% over the past 15 years. Based on past performance, reaching millionaire status could take between 27 and 36 years with a consistent $300 monthly investment.

feed.title: Morgan Stanley course-corrects their semiconductor equipment outlook on demand
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley has revised its outlook for the semiconductor production equipment industry, noting that April-June results showed few positive catalysts except for Advantest. While other Japanese equipment makers' shares fell despite meeting forecasts, Advantest raised its full-year guidance, indicating strengthening wafer fabrication equipment (WFE) demand led by DRAM and advanced logic. Morgan Stanley maintains Advantest as its top pick and also favors Tokyo Electron, anticipating upside to its second-half sales and profit.

feed.title: HCA Healthcare Jumps 6.0% After JP Morgan Maintains Neutral
feed.summary: HCA Healthcare shares surged 6.0% to $430.79 on Friday, despite JP Morgan cutting its price target from $490 to $425 and maintaining a Neutral rating. The unexpected rally suggests investors may be looking beyond the analyst's more conservative outlook, possibly anticipating stronger operational performance or improved industry fundamentals. This divergence highlights the complexity of market sentiment around HCA, a major hospital operator, as trading volume reached 750,059 shares.

feed.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges iTonic Holdings Ltd. f/k/a Pheton Holdings Ltd. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
feed.summary: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman, LLC has filed a class action lawsuit against iTonic Holdings Ltd. (NASDAQ: ITOC; previously PTHL) alleging federal securities law violations. The lawsuit claims iTonic made false and misleading statements during the Class Period (September 5, 2024, to July 29, 2025), failing to disclose an alleged market manipulation and fraudulent promotion scheme. Investors who purchased iTonic Class A ordinary shares during this period are encouraged to join the case before the lead plaintiff deadline of September 29, 2026.

feed.title: DexCom Study Demonstrates CGM Benefits in Type 2 Diabetes
feed.summary: A new study by DexCom, called CONNECT, shows that their Dexcom G7 continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system significantly lowers A1C and improves glucose control in people with Type 2 diabetes who do not use insulin, when compared to standard self-monitoring of blood glucose. This trial involved 440 participants and demonstrated benefits across various demographics and medication regimens, suggesting that CGM could become a new standard of care for this patient group. The results highlight substantial reductions in A1C and increased time in the target glucose range for Dexcom G7 users.

feed.title: Hall of Famer Walter Jones Will Join 1,000-Pair Shoe Giveaway in Yakima
feed.summary: Coordinated Care, a subsidiary of Centene (NYSE: CNC), is launching a nine-day statewide health tour in Washington with its "SeeMore" vision van and "Flossy" dental van. The tour will provide free vision and dental screenings, prescription glasses, fluoride treatments, and dental kits, particularly targeting rural and underinvested communities. Seattle Seahawks legend Walter Jones will participate in the final stop in Yakima, where 1,000 pairs of shoes will be given away to children.

feed.title: Coordinated Care Brings Free Health Screenings to Washington Communities with Statewide Vision & Dental Van Tour
feed.summary: Coordinated Care, a subsidiary of Centene Corporation, is launching a nine-day statewide tour in Washington to offer free vision and dental screenings to communities, especially in rural areas. The initiative utilizes mobile vans, "SeeMore" and "Flossy," to provide services like prescription glasses, fluoride treatments, and health resources, irrespective of Coordinated Care membership. Seattle Seahawks legend Walter Jones will join the final stop in Yakima to distribute 1,000 free pairs of shoes to children.

feed.title: Micron Establishes Boise Research Hub for Memory and AI
feed.summary: Micron Technology has announced the establishment of Micron Research Labs, a new U.S.-based research institution headquartered in Boise, backed by a planned $10 billion investment over the next decade. This hub will focus on critical memory technologies, advanced memory and compute architectures, packaging, and future semiconductor manufacturing, bringing together industry, academia, and government to drive breakthroughs for the AI era. The initiative builds on Micron's previous commitment of over $250 billion for manufacturing and R&D in the U.S., aiming to reinforce American leadership in memory and advanced manufacturing.

feed.title: Las Vegas Sands stock holds after analysts keep a hold rating
feed.summary: Las Vegas Sands (LVS) stock maintains a "Hold" rating from analysts despite its latest quarterly report missing EPS and revenue estimates. The company closed at $45.98 on August 20, 2026, with analysts setting an average target of $61.88, while the stock trades below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages. LVS continues to rely on its large integrated resorts, including Marina Bay Sands and Macau properties, which contribute to its revenue mix.

feed.title: JPMorgan hiring Bank of America’s David Fishman as head of technology M&A, memo says
feed.summary: JPMorgan Chase is hiring David Fishman from Bank of America to lead its North America technology mergers and acquisitions within a new investment banking group focused on key tech clients. This move comes as Bank of America experiences several senior investment banker departures, though it has also made numerous managing director hires this year to bolster its teams. Fishman will join JPMorgan later this year, with Vineet Seth being elevated to vice chair of investment banking.

feed.title: Targa Resources Secures 20-Year Deal With ExxonMobil
feed.summary: Targa Resources has announced a 20-year, fee-based agreement with ExxonMobil for gas processing, gathering, and NGL transportation in the Permian Basin, leading to a significant expansion of Targa's infrastructure. This deal involves adding approximately 825 million cubic feet per day of processing capacity and building the Bull Run II natural gas pipeline, with a revised FY26 net growth capital estimate of around $5 billion. The long-term contract provides Targa with enhanced cash-flow visibility and strengthens its position in the energy infrastructure sector.

feed.title: Weyerhaeuser stock holds steady as housing demand supports valuations
feed.summary: Weyerhaeuser stock is trading in the mid-$20s, supported by steady timber demand and dividend income, despite higher interest rates impacting the US housing market. Analysts maintain a "moderate buy" consensus with a target price of $29.00, indicating potential upside, and institutional investors continue to show interest in the timberland REIT. The company's valuation reflects its core business of sustainable timberland management and exposure to cyclical housing activity, with its dividend policy sensitive to lumber demand and log prices.

feed.title: Pentair plc (PNR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Have Opportunity to Lead Securities Fraud Lawsuit
authors: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz
feed.summary: The Law Offices of Frank R. Cruz announce a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Pentair plc (PNR) for investors who suffered losses. The lawsuit alleges that between March 11, 2026, and July 14, 2026, Pentair failed to disclose significant inventory destocking in its Pool channel, which adversely affected its sales and operating income. Investors have until October 2, 2026, to apply to be lead plaintiff in the case.

feed.title: UBS Lifts Iovance Biotherapeutics Price Target as Cancer Drug Sales Top Expectations

Despite the positive financial results and a substantial stock surge, UBS maintained a "Neutral" rating due to valuation concerns and potential risks like competitive pressure. The raised price target and positive earnings revisions from other analysts indicate growing confidence in the company's growth trajectory, although some caution remains regarding the stock's already impressive rally.

feed.title: AVOIDABLE: Molina Healthcare Settles TCPA Wrong Number Class Action For $1.93MM– and This Doesn’t Have to Keep Happening
feed.summary: Molina Healthcare has settled a TCPA class action lawsuit for $1.93 million, stemming from prerecorded calls made to wrong numbers. The settlement highlights the financial risks companies face when making non-marketing calls to reassigned numbers and underscores the importance of using the Reassigned Numbers Database (RND) and avoiding problematic "wrong number" disposition tracking. The article emphasizes that such class actions are largely avoidable with proper protocols.

feed.title: Delta picks Amazon over Starlink for in-flight Wi-Fi
feed.summary: Delta Air Lines has chosen Amazon's Project Kuiper (Leo) satellite internet for its in-flight Wi-Fi, starting in 2028, over Starlink. This decision, driven by cost savings and integration with Amazon's tech ecosystem, means Delta will equip 500 aircraft to offer free high-speed Wi-Fi to SkyMiles members. Despite competitors already using Starlink, Delta believes its long-term strategy with Amazon will provide better value.

feed.title: HPQ Set to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
feed.summary: HP Inc. (HPQ) is scheduled to release its fiscal third-quarter 2026 results on August 26. Analysts expect revenues of $14.60 billion and non-GAAP earnings per share between 61 and 71 cents, with the Zacks Consensus Estimate for earnings at 66 cents, representing a year-over-year decline. The company's performance is likely to be driven by strength in its Personal Systems business, especially AI PCs and premium models, but profitability could be impacted by rising memory prices and other inflationary pressures.

feed.title: HPE Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Storage Platforms

The company's innovative HPE Alletra Storage MP, particularly the X10000 for unstructured data and AI workloads, and the B10000 for flexible block and file storage, are key to its leadership in enterprise data management and cyber resilience.

feed.title: Boeing white-collar union contract vote results expected today
feed.summary: Voting on Boeing's contract offer to its largest white-collar union, SPEEA, concludes today, with results anticipated by mid-afternoon in Seattle. While Boeing offered terms described as better than expected to avoid a strike, neither the engineers nor the technicians unit councils fully endorsed the offer, with technicians recommending rejection. A key point of contention in the proposed four-year contract is the 3% cap on inflation-based wage increases, which some members believe will lead to salaries falling behind inflation.
